open_obligations.obstruction: The synthesis handle names prefix and suffix argmin sets and rank increments but supplies no finite quotient, transition table, register program, or invariant proving that every facet enters one of finitely many successor types. The all-length staircase proof does not classify facets outside that family.

The direct letter updates include both opposing shear directions, so no fixed order of the two obvious endpoint registers is triangular; this does not exclude a different encoding using the allowed sixteen registers. Finite catalogues through small support cannot establish the all-length bijection.

open_obligations.obstruction: Finite-sample honesty follows from exact nuisance-supremum inversion and error allocation, but the frozen primitives do not contain a uniform local conditional-multinomial quantile theorem or an inversion lemma. A pointwise multinomial central-limit heuristic yields the efficient influence-function variance, but promoting it to the stated interval equivalence would silently assume the needed uniform quantile and inversion result.
